name: Filtration
teachingNotes: Ordinary gravity filtration separates insoluble solid particles from a liquid suspension. It does NOT remove dissolved chemical solutes or soluble ions.

steps.prompt: Step 1: Seat filter paper. Click or drag the folded Filter Paper into the Funnel, then click the Wash Bottle.
steps.hint: Moistening the paper with solvent from the wash bottle creates a hydraulic seal against the glass funnel wall.
steps.completionText: Filter paper cone seated and moistened. Airtight hydraulic seal established.

steps.prompt: Step 2: Position receiver. Click the Conical Flask so the funnel bevel tip rests against the vessel wall.
steps.hint: Touching the bevel tip to the inner glass wall allows liquid to slide smoothly down without splashing.
steps.completionText: Receiving vessel positioned with funnel tip resting against inner glass wall.

steps.prompt: Step 3: Decant mixture! Click or hold the 'Pour Slurry' button to guide the suspension down the glass rod.
steps.hint: Use surface tension along the stirring rod to direct liquid into the cone. Do not fill higher than 2/3 full!
steps.completionText: Slurry poured smoothly along stirring rod without overflowing the filter rim.

steps.prompt: Step 4: Gravity drainage. Watch the liquid phase drain through the pores into the receiver flask.
steps.hint: Gravity drives the clear filtrate through cellulose fibers while insoluble residue accumulates on the paper.
steps.completionText: Filtration in progress: clear liquid collects in receiver; solid precipitate stays on paper cone.

steps.prompt: Step 5: Inspection. Click the Filter Paper cone to inspect the isolated solid residue cake.
steps.hint: Notice that the liquid in the receiving flask is completely transparent and free of sediment.
steps.completionText: Separation verified: solid residue isolated on filter paper; clear filtrate in receiver. Note: dissolved salts remain in filtrate.

overflow.message: Overflow warning! The slurry level rose above the filter paper rim. Unfiltered suspension spilled behind the paper and contaminated the filtrate.

dry_paper.message: Filter paper was not seated with solvent! Air pockets will allow liquid bypass around the paper.

wrong_apparatus.message: Select the correct equipment indicated in the current instruction.
